angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 42,228,990 km at 1845.10 pc = 0.31 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, DL Cas: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1845.1 +/- 182.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1845.1 +/- 182.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.5528 +/- 0.0274 mas (same row, RUWE 1.88), 20.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 60.7 +/- 6 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, DL Cas: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 60.7 +/- 6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 42,228,990 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 177 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 69, Name='DL Cas', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 177 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 69, Name='DL Cas', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 177 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
